title: Rooms For Students
body: The university offers accomodation to first year students only. Everyone else has to look for a flat in the city, and prices near the campus rise sharply in September.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **accommodation**. Hem c hem m çift yazılır: ac-com-mo-da-tion.

title: A Clear Answer
body: She is definately coming to the meeting on Thursday. She confirmed it twice and even asked which room we had booked for the group.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **definitely**. İçinde finite geçer, a değil i vardır: de-fin-ite-ly.

title: Small Habits
body: Protecting the enviroment starts with small habits at home. Turning off the lights, repairing clothes and buying less plastic change more than most people expect.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **environment**. n harfi atlanmış: en-viron-ment.

title: New Rules
body: The goverment announced new rules for public transport last month. Tickets are cheaper for students, but the discount only works with a registered card.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **government**. govern kökünden gelir, n düşmez: govern-ment.

title: Before The Trip
body: It is neccessary to bring your passport, not just a photo of it. The office refuses copies and you will lose your place in the queue.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **necessary**. Tek c, çift s vardır: nec-es-sary.

title: A Rare Evening
body: The dinner was a special occassion for the whole department. People who had not spoken for years sat at the same table and talked until midnight.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **occasion**. c çift, s tektir: oc-ca-sion.

title: What Worked
body: The most succesful students in the group were not the fastest ones. They simply reviewed their notes every week instead of reading everything twice before the exam.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **successful**. success çift s ile biter, sonra tek l'li -ful eki gelir.

title: Worth Reading
body: I would reccomend the second book rather than the first one. It explains the same ideas with clearer examples and it costs almost nothing second hand.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **recommend**. Tek c, çift m vardır: re-com-mend.

title: Wrong Name
body: He felt embarassed after calling the manager by the wrong name twice in one meeting. Nobody mentioned it, which somehow made the feeling worse.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **embarrassed**. Hem r hem s çift yazılır: em-bar-rassed.

title: No Delay
body: If the alarm rings, leave the building imediately and wait at the gate. Do not return for bags, laptops or anything else you left on the desk.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **immediately**. m çift yazılır: im-me-di-ate-ly.

title: One Place Left
body: This is a real oportunity for anyone who wants laboratory experience. Only one place is left and applications close at the end of the week.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **opportunity**. p çift yazılır: op-por-tu-ni-ty.

title: Who Does What
body: Each member is responsable for one section of the report. If somebody misses the deadline, the whole group loses marks, so we agreed on weekly checks.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **responsible**. Sonu -able değil -ible ile biter.

title: Living Alone
body: Living alone made him more independant than he expected. Cooking, paying bills and repairing small things taught him more in six months than two years of advice.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **independent**. Sonu -ant değil -ent ile biter.

title: What Counts
body: The company asks for two years of experiance, but they often accept students who have done a serious internship and can explain what they actually did.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **experience**. Sonu -ance değil -ence ile biter.

title: More Than Facts
body: Real knowlege is not a pile of facts. It shows up when you can explain the same idea to somebody who has never heard of the subject.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **knowledge**. know + ledge; d harfi atlanmış.

title: Keeping Time
body: The drummer keeps the rythm steady while the others change speed. Without him the whole band would fall apart in the middle of every song.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **rhythm**. Baştaki h atlanmış: rh-y-thm.

title: A Full Week
body: My schedual is full until Friday afternoon. If the meeting cannot wait, the only free hour is early tomorrow morning before the lecture starts.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **schedule**. Sonu -ual değil -ule ile biter.

title: An Old Photo
body: The photo was a complete suprise for my mother. Nobody in the family knew that a picture from her first school year still existed.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **surprise**. İlk r atlanmış: sur-prise.

title: Cold Classroom
body: The temprature in the seminar room drops quickly after five o'clock. Students who stay late usually bring a jacket even in the middle of spring.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **temperature**. Ortadaki e düşmüş: tem-per-a-ture.

title: Small Steps
body: You will not acheive a good result in one night. Twenty minutes every day beats five hours on Sunday, especially with listening and speaking practice.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **achieve**. i ve e yer değiştirmiş: a-chie-ve.

title: Two Sides
body: Her arguement was clear but it completely ignored the cost. The other group answered with real numbers, and after that the discussion became much shorter.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **argument**. argue kelimesinin sonundaki e düşer.

title: The Decision
body: The commitee meets once a month and decides which projects receive money. Anyone can send a proposal, but late applications are never read at all.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **committee**. m, t ve e üçü de çift yazılır: com-mit-tee.

title: Not What We Hoped
body: We were dissapointed with the whole trip, mainly because of the weather. The museum itself was excellent and the guide answered every question patiently.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **disappointed**. dis + appoint; s tek, p çift olur.

title: Another Language
body: Learning a foriegn language as an adult takes real patience. Children copy sounds without thinking, while adults keep translating in their heads for months.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **foreign**. Bu kelime kurala uymaz: e önce, i sonra gelir.

title: Read The Label
body: Take the medecine after food, never on an empty stomach. If you forget one dose, skip it rather than taking two at the same time.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **medicine**. Ortadaki harf e değil i: med-i-cine.
